jin_speed.description: Allows the model to set the movement speed used by subsequent JIN_POSITION avatar gestures.
rules: Use to set how quickly the collapsed live JIN avatar moves when JIN_POSITION is executed.
Emit marker using exactly this schema <JIN_SPEED> 600px/s </JIN_SPEED>
Put only the speed payload inside the tag body; do not put it in the opening tag.
The value is pixels per second and persists for later JIN_POSITION actions until changed.
Small values such as 20-80px/s create a slow crawl; large values such as 2000-6000px/s create a quick jump-like move.
Use CURRENT_JIN_SPEED as the current movement speed.
